description:
[read-only] A brand's profile (website, companyName, tagline, industry, audience, values, pillars, hashtag sets), its default voice, colors and fonts. `brandId` comes from list_brands; a brand-bound connection may omit it.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brand/intelligence.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key is pinned to its own brand (may be omitted; another brand → 403); an account-wide key must name one.

name: brand_profile_get
title: Get a brand profile
